description: This file defines the ConfiguratorController class for SuiteCRM, which extends SugarController. It handles various administrative actions related to fonts, configuration settings, admin wizard, and history contacts/emails within the SuiteCRM module. The class includes methods for managing fonts, saving configurations, displaying views, and processing related data.

classes.name: ConfiguratorController
classes.description: Controller class managing admin functionalities such as font management, configuration saving, and user interface views within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_FontManager
methods.description: Sets the view to font manager after verifying admin rights.

methods.name: action_deleteFont
methods.description: Deletes a specified font and redirects back to the font manager, verifying admin rights.

methods.name: action_listview
methods.description: Sets the view to edit list after verifying admin rights.

methods.name: action_addFontView
methods.description: Displays the add font view, verifying admin rights.

methods.name: action_addFont
methods.description: Handles adding a new font, validating uploaded files and extensions, then displays result view.

methods.name: action_saveadminwizard
methods.description: Saves administrator settings, handles scenarios, and redirects to user wizard.

methods.name: action_saveconfig
methods.description: Saves configuration changes, clears caches, and redirects to admin index.

methods.name: action_detail
methods.description: Sets the view to edit for displaying configuration details, verifying admin rights.

methods.name: action_historyContactsEmails
methods.description: Displays the history contacts & emails view.

methods.name: action_historyContactsEmailsSave
methods.description: Processes the saving of history contacts and emails module visibility settings.
